review_text: I don't know what happened to this app. It was super on point up until a year or so ago. Can't do quick resend of money unless I go back to ones I did in early 2024. Finally got my points when they "fixed" it. Went from 110 to 1290 that's how long it's been screwed up. Super frustrating to use now since I consistently send the same person money. I'd rather go into a store or call just to get it done because this app is trash now. Sorry not sorry.

app was good. then the randomly locked my account a couple days ago demanding a lot of personal information about myself and the people I am sending money too and my relationship with them, as well as my banking information and where my money comes from. this is none of their business and I will find another way to send/receive money. I've been a loyal customer for many years but will no longer use this ridiculous service

Terrible user interface 🤬 Menus cluttered. App display is garbled and/or disappears if I temporarily switch to another app to copy & paste my bank account number. It won't let me paste! If I multitask and switch to another app, WU disappears and I see the phone wallpaper instead. There are OBVIOUSLY issues with screen refresh. App is sluggish and poorly designed. I'm using Google Pixel 9 Pro XL (latest Android 15 update). Do better!

I got this app to send money quickly without having to wait in lines at the store. Unfortunately it only worked a few times. After that it would say the money would be there in minutes but once I paid it would change to say it would take 3 days. After the 3 days it would either cancel or refund the money. Which is good because I wouldn't lose the money but it also never made it to my family members. I reached out to them asking why this kept happening but all they did was track my order.

You're honestly better off using another app or your bank account to wire money. A scammer tried to hack into my account and send money and when I called customer service for help the only solution they had was to deactivate my account indefinitely. They actually deactivated my account after I got off the phone and they just sent me an email. Terrible!! I also had another issue with them trying to send money. They have an ancient systems in place. Western Union needs to do better!

worked fine on my 2 transfers. Then, it was impossible to log in, even resetting my password. The page was loading forever. My account got locked even when I answered my security question correctly. Will call to resolve the issue. Until then, 1 star is plenty for the trouble I went through.

Every time I try to send money to India, it gives an error code. WU has my bank info, and only charges 99¢ for bank transfers. But they ALWAYS fail, because they want you to spend MORE using a different account, like credit card. It takes weeks for them to "fix" your account for the transfer to work. The next time you want to send money, IT HAPPENS ALL OVER AGAIN! I cannot decide if they are incompetent, or are forcing the system to fail on the cheapest transfer in order for you to pay more. 👎

When it works it's great but for some reason when you get to the black screen where it says that it needs more information and your supposed to press next, the next button is missing and you cannot proceed with making your selection as to why you are sending money. Hope they fix this issue because I use this app too much for it not to be working properly!!!

Terrible been trying to send money to Australia it keeps saying technical error please try again later. It's giving me the error code 400 every time. What is that mean? I entered everything correctly even double check but it's still not going thru. I've been using this app for years to send money to family members before I had no problem but suddenly I think starting two months ago it's giving me problems. It takes forever to load, I think it takes me like 45 minutes trying to send money.

The app says it's simple easy to use but it is not. I am officially getting frustrated because every time I send send money to one of my loved ones they always ask the same question what is it for and then I always get an email saying profile updated and then I get another email saying transaction was sent It is annoying that this isn't constant thing and the app is just too much there is so many different things that lead you to this lead you to that The only thing simple is the quick send

Despite the high fees, the app contains annoying ads and popups. If you refuse to let it bother you with unnecessary notifications, there are frequent popups that that make it difficult to log in. Worse, it will corrupt the name of the sender randomly. This means that it will send to the wrong person, requiring that one cancel the transaction. This may tie one's money up for a week while they wait for a refund. Horrible app. There are many alternatives. Use them instead.

Tried this on Dec 2019 to send money back home for Christmas. It kept saying transaction can not be completed so I kept trying. It finally went thru . A few days later I was surprised to get an email that a second transaction went through. Good thing I had enough funds to cover the duplicate transaction. To make matters worse I was also charged a fee for that duplicate transaction. Today I thought I would give the app a second chance. Maybe they made improvements. NOPE! Stay away, people!

If you have this app Uninstall and delete it as soon as possible. It is useless and refuses to allow transfers of any amount. Customer service is also useless, they do not reply to emails about issues not do they show any of interest in fixing the issues with the app. If I could give a negative stars rating it would be minus 10. Since updating the app sucks. Will not allow transfers over 40$ . Will not share pickup numbers. Kicks me out of transfers, then sends messages to return to finish.

Ads appear right under the "Continue" button right before you click on it to finish a transaction, leading to accidental clicks on potentially malicious ads. This is dangerous for people who aren't tech savvy which is probably the point. Not sure why this app even has ads as they already charge for transactions. Would use something else if I could but this is the only service available for both sender And receiver.

WU ate up my 96 WU points. I wrote multiple emails. No Response yet. Also, the app doesn't work any more. It gives msg "Application error: Connection to the server was unsuccessful" and closes itself. I could easily transfer money to my bank accounts earlier. However,after updating the app, it doesn't work any more. Tried calling customer care but they are not helpful. So Uninstalling.

Got completely screwed and had to pay $100 more. Called into customer care, and they said my transaction had been approved, but there was a system error keeping it in limbo. They said that in order to fix it, they had to cancel it, and i had to reprocess. I asked if I would get a new rate or keep the same thing I had. Care representative lied to me and said i would pay the same. I called in to see if I could get some kind of credit and they spit in my face with a $3 credit.

I chose a transfer from my checking account because I thought it would be cheaper and faster. Warning, it may take 5 days!!! I could have mailed a check faster!! Terrible app and a horrible company. They adverise "fast cash in minutes" and it never is. Ive had an account with them for years. I send money regularly to the same family members. They have my passport on file. Yet they ALWAYS hold and complicate a transaction. You have to spend HOURS on the phone trying to get YOUR money. Appalling

I attempted to send money to a friend, and it keeps saying that the address for my card and the address on my profile don't match, so I can't send money. The thing is, they are exactly the same! I deleted my card and re-entered it, as well as added another card that had funds as well, but to no avail, as I received the same error. I don't feel comfortable going to the store given the climate, but unfortunately it looks like I may have to go that anyway.

Un-installing the app as it has no more use for me. Several transfer requests were declined without explanation. I tried five times. Every time I had to wait for hours just to get a declined notice. I checked the info several times for correctness. Customer service was totally useless. They even got nasty at times which I do not appreciate. Finally had it. Found a different service, less expensive, much better conversion rates, and easy to use.

Used to be very convenient app for years. I used it regularly with no issues at all. Bit suddenly in June 2024, the app started to give me hard time and it is impossible to use it anymore. I use my residential address as my billing address but the app says I can't use PO Box. I called customer support but they were beyond jokes ! I've been waiting for a week already. Will switch to another app if the issue won't be solved in a few days ! Disappointing !

I am becoming frustrated by Western Union bugs in the system. There is an issue that caused ANY in-store transfters to not appear on the history tab even after multiple transfers. I complained about it multiple times to them, and each time, I was referred to check it out on the website, and when I did, it didn't appear there either. I will have it sit at 1 star until this issue gets fixed. I even reinstalled the app multiple times, which still doesn't explain the issues with the online portal.

The app has steep fees to transfer money. With all of the money sending options that most banks offer, it makes no sense to charge so much to wirelessly send money. I would avoid using this service unless you have no choice. There are cheaper and easier ways to send money. Also, after every transfer, they hit you with 4 or 5 "Offers." However, they're really just advertising to you. "You just won an opportunity to win $1000 Walmart gift card! Just go to this website and make an account!" Etc.

This app need significant improvement. When you minimize the app to get information requested, it closes on you. You have to log in again and it doesn't save entered information so you have to start over each time. The worst part is when you use your bank account to transfer, it is asking for your online ID, security question answer, and password! This is unheard of. All they need is bank's routing and account number. Why should anyone give away their banking access? This is terrible!

Except for a slight confusion at the dialog windows ( password reset ) it does just what I want it to do. 9/2/19....Password no longer a problem; however, I find that no matter how I choose, debit card or credit card, I'm always charged at the credit card rate for the fee.... Very irritating. I'm still being charged at the credit card rate instead of the debit card rate.... What's going on with this app.... Every time I have to fight with this item,the more I'm convinced to use Money Gram

Newest version won't let me login with my fingerprint without enabling permission, such as access to my contacts, photos, videos, location, etc. Not gonna happen. Update the app and I'll change the rating. Also, few months back I sent money internationally. It was supposed to take up to 5 days, which is fine with me. It was a direct bank transfer. It took something like 3 weeks. Unacceptable! Especially when you have people depending on it.

I attempted multiple times to send money abroad using this app. Every time i submitted a transfer, there was a problem. Either a hold placed on the transfer with no notification to me, a weird misspelling of the recipient even though it showed correctly in the record, and then the money just not being available to the recipient after customer service stated all was ready for pickup. I ended up having to go to a store to successfully complete a money transfer. Worthless app to me.

the worst transfert app ever. the app itself is already slow and buggy to interact with. the moment u open the app 💥 ads,ads,ads,ads. the app design is unprofessional, which means that it's ugly. after disable the certain permissions, It's a nightmare every time I open the app, with this system notification pop-up trying to force me to allow unnecessary permissions, even though the app could've worked perfectly fine without those permissions [contact,camera,notification,ect]but refuse.

The best way to send money. UPDATE. Had to bring it down from 5 stars. The last few times I've had a hard time inputting the amount, because it rejects my entry on either currency...probably a rounding error issue, so I keep entering different amounts until I hit the matching (round) amount that it can accept as valid. UPDATE2) I sent "money in minutes" and the review team is holding my money...I send thousands of dollars every year and NOW they decide to hold my money for who knows what!!!

Not Reliable. It did not remember my pass word. When I went to reset, there was no security messures so any one could have gone into my account. The only reason I gave this app a two was when I went online from my computer and saw my last transactions. I changed my mind back to a one because security is top priority along eith providing a service. I will return to money gram.

Worst app I have ever used. Redirects me to an ad when I am trying to pay. Gets stuck on loading forever. Constant annoying popups. A complete joke. I am paying a fee and you are bombarding me with ads and popups. I will just use another service. Shouldn't have to worry about clicking an ad instead of "send" when handling large financial transactions.

I normally don't leave one star reviews. Unfortunately, over the last few months of using this app, it has serious issues. In 8 months of using it on a biweekly basis, I have had to reinstall the entire app, clear my phone cache and restart it every single time I make a payment. I have only had one occasion where the app loaded successfully for two payments. This is on top of numerous stability issues I encounter when it does work. The error code I get is longer than the word limit for reviews

ONE STAR. Please make sure the app is flawless before rolling it out to the mass. I processed a transfer via the app and chose the "pay in-store" option, which was $5. However, the WU agent was unable to complete the transaction because they were unable to enter my ID# into the system for processing. Note that the APP did not require me to input my ID when I created the transfer initially. The agent was calling WU on behalf of me to get this resolved, but was transferred FIVE times, where she had to repeatedly explain what the issue was. An hour later, the supervisor "Dan" offered a 50% off the $14 store transaction fee to be applied to the current transaction. He was very unprofessional and hung up on my agent before we could ask another question. It seems like no one in WU knows what they're doing.

No way was I denied to use their service. I'm taking back my 5-star review after using them for years... all of a sudden, with no reason as to why they don't want to do business with me. When I have never had any issues on my account. I have complied with all additional information they've ever requested, like aid bank statements w2 haha you name it ive submitted. We'll guess I'm switching my business to any of the other competitors out there. Thanks for no clarification as to why.

This app was a good one, until recently, when it just stopped working on android (Samsung galaxy note 9 here). It just crashes in the middle of the process, when I pick a receiver from the list of receivers it saved from my previous transactions. Please take care, it's been more than 3 weeks since it behaves like that. Had to use an old iOS device to send money. It works as expected on iOS, no complaints.

App has become very intrusive. After declining to store my debit card, I had to decline once again during processing my transfer. Also, despite using a debit card in my name as it appears in my WU account, it requested that I enter my ID details.. and upon completion of the transfer I was presented with several Ads before seeing the final transfer result and that stinks. I think I am going to uninstall this intrusive app.

Useless for people who actually care about security. Refuses to work on rooted devices. Edit: Telling us it won't work on rooted devices doesn't require anything other than a rooted device. If you intended this behavior (which I believe from the message in the app), you do not need to know my device. Remove the offending code, and let people have their secure and rooted devices with your app. Otherwise, simply admit that you don't offer a service to those who secure their phones through rooting.

Not loving the new look/update. Took multiple attempts to send. Updated 9/1/2023: lost a star since your app can't seem to save my address change. I changed it almost 3 years ago and have to input the information every time only for it to be unchanged on the final page. 12/01/2023 Fully connected yet told I had. To connect to a service or WiFi. My address change still won't stick.

Barely usable. I am able to use it most of the time, but with my teeth loudly grinding. At every step (you are forced to go through many steps/screens) the rotating "loading" circle can become infinite, never-ending, requiring to close and reopen the App, restart the process. The App is unable to tell which location has which restriction (amount to be sent, if they do transactions initiated on the smartphone, etc.), so frustration continues when I have to drive from one location to another. Bad.

This is the third time that when I'm receiving money from a friend, I'd use the app to sign up for pick up and as soon as I get to the store to pick up cash the system would say that it is unavailable even if the app and the website says it is available. I waste time and gas money, having to call/chat customer rep and then drive back up again to the store and redo the whole process. The chat option in the app didn't even work beyond the putting tracking # in so I had to call instead.

I think it's ridiculous to charge twice as much fees then a store . I understand the app should be convenient , but charging $22 to send $100 when the store only charges $10. the store is all over my town , neasrest one I can walk to . I would even use the app even if you charge me $3 more . Maybe add a feature to the app so you can at least see if the person have a store nearby. Only the ones not leaving no where near a store will pay that. there are plenty apps that help wire money easy $0 fee

App works usually but the added popups for so called "discounts" and such is completely unwanted anr annoying since it moves the decline button wherever it feels like. Your fees are already too high, stop penny pinching. Edit: Now ads that make the app sluggish and load slower. Plus right next to the next button. Now removing two more stars to make this app one star. It almost doesn't do it's only function.

How does preventing screen capture become a more secure feature? It's quite idiotic. This is in line with the premise of forcing users to use extremely long and complex passwords. The result is that the user inevitably creates a spreadsheet with all of their passwords or write them down on a post it note and stick it on the screen. It does not make using the app more secure period! It actually does the opposite.

they've added fee even for bank to bank transfers and exchange rate is not good. other apps are giving better rates than western union. only reason I used this before was, it didn't charge a fee for bank to bank transfers and now it does. will not use anymore 👎 On top of that there are several pop-ups within the app and also there is another hookup which keeps on asking if I want to add Chase bank account. Very annoying. That's why I avoid using it

Update: A new annoyance: the app pops up a "permission denied" notice and prompts "allow access to contacts" no less than 5 times in a single transaction. Transfer recipients are stored in the app and there is no reason whatsoever other than privacy intrusion that there is a need for access to my contacts. FIX THIS PLEASE. Looking for an alternative to WU. Customer support sucks. The app sucks. Fees are high.

I was attempting to send money to friend, very time sensitive. I entered my card info perfectly, only to be told at very end that that option wasn't available, and to give cash in person to agent (?). Why suggest 4 different options on app if you can only go in person, which is inefficient and unsafe during a pandemic? Oh and they still refuse to admit that they messed up my previous transaction despite clear evidence that they failed to follow legal and regulatory requirements

Constantly has issues or creates issues. UPDATE: I cancelled the last transfer because your app is too slow for the fees to be so high, and crashes constantly. But you didn't cancel, you wasted my time again and again. Then kept the transfer fee anyway. I'll begin using XE and other means to send money for much less cost and aggravation. Congratulations. Great job.

Doesn't work at all. Just waste your time. It's offers online transfers with a great deals and discounts. But once you spend a lot of time to complete it - always it write you that "we're sorry we can't finish it online please find our location to finish it". And fees immediately increase from 2.99$ to 34.99$ (for example but my last payemnts it was about this numbers). SCAM. WorldRemit, Xoom and many others much more better - it takes seconds to finish transaction with the lowest fee.

App is not rendering properly on Pixel 2XL. It looks strected with text cutting off on the edges of the screen. Update: I contacted your support and they were pretty much useless. I have shared screenshots of the app showing where the issue was and all i got in response was debugging methods for the western union website, nothing app specific.

It charged me for the price of using a CC $17.49 when I entered a debit card. WU has charged me twice for a $100 send when I only sent $100 to one person. When I caught it on my bank statement, I moved across the State and it got to late to dispute it along with 2 extra $10 charges. I sent money thru the app n chose the $5 fee for doing it in store n it charged me $40 nit $5. I have sent money many times on this this app but it only shows 2 in history. Would of liked All of them saved WU!!!!

I have used WU services dozens of times and it truly is the worst service I've ever experienced. The App shuts me out of my log in all the time. The brick and mortar locations are literally 75% of the time not functioning. I'm told the WU system is down, I cannot send or recieve money. I have driven from location to location and told the same thing. It was out for weeks at about 10 different locations in my area recently, so I just haven't been able to access my money for months. I gave up.

Slow, unintuitive, freakishly unhelpful, I can't redeem my points and slow... so slow, I listed it twice. 0 stars actually. Their customer service is even worse. I was told I'd be called in 1 hour and waited 90 minutes, called them, was put on hold for 10 more minutes and hung up.

One star is only because in the end, the app gets the job done. User experience, however, is terrible. The app marks all fields (except for the name) as optional, then during send, it tells you, they are required. The foreign country of my contract is clearly identified, yet it keeps asking for the US state when trying to send. It won't let me specify contact's address in the native language of that country, forcing me to transliterate every word, making the address meaningless to the receiver.

Completely useless. The app I no longer allowing you to send money online. Only in person. Customer service is a waste of time. No explanation as to why you can't send money. Just "it's a federal reason" and then no explanation as to why. You have points. You can't use them, but forever told in the app. You have points expiring soon. Western union isn't. Even in all locations. Stop & shop doesn't allow it even tho they should. Hate wasting time to send money, hunting for a store that has it.

Garbage app. No way to select/change home country, so I keep getting bill payment options for a country I don't live in. I'm not in the US, and only 1 app was offered for download. Why they would splice into country specific apps is beyond me, especially when a major component of their service is moving money across currency/borders. WU should have ended in the 1980's because they failed to keep up with the times.

WU will (randomly?) hold your money hostage, not allowing you to cancel a transaction while only providing a message that the transaction is in process and to check back shortly. Well, 8 days later after no notification of any problem I had to go through several departments until they informed me that I had to email them my ID. You know, the one I used to OPEN THE ACCOUNT. And that no I could not cancel the transfer, either. I will never use this "service" again.

A note to the owner or team that updates and controls the app, I use an Android phone, and I can no longer even open this app anymore, I don't know if it has a bug or what, but please see what you can to fix it. I click on it, and it immediately closes. I click on it again, and it immediately closes again. Cannot use the app at all. What's going on?

This app is horrible, sure. The app is extremely slow and unresponsive. Also there is no correlation between the app and coustmer service. In other words the app is in another galaxy. Also when entering senders information some how the middle name and second last name get transcribed. In other words the second last name will occupy the middle name when you go to edit the name. I have screen image if necessary. Thanks

Horrible experience. 4G service on my phone, app just spins and spins. Give up. Go to Walgreen's kiosk, no service there either. Call them, enter all the info, connects me with heavy accent person. Had to give her all the same info. Instead of paying $6.99 online, phone fee is $9.99. Next time I'll use paypal, very easy, no fees.

I've been a frequent user of this app since 2016. Started having issues using this app since 09/18. Every time I make an attempt to make a transaction an error message keeps popping up, "We are unable to complete your transaction at this time, please visit an agent location." It was once convenient to send remittances to my loved ones at the touch of a button. Now I am not able to do so due to technical issues the company refuses to fix. Customer service agents are of no help!! DISAPPOINTMENT!!!

It's painfully difficult to transfer money outside the US, 99% of it gives an error, and then randomly it works!!!!!!! It takes an average 20 attempts to be able to do it. :( I called costumer service, they told me they could not help me with an app related issue, because they have no control over the app, and they can't check what was done in the app.... And all of this was yesterday BTW....

App wouldn't let me send money with either of my cards, and kept declining transfers. I checked my info multiple times and everything was correct. Claimed to send money "in minutes" but when I contacted customer service they told me it could take hours. After multiple attempts to send money through this app, I am going to have to find another way to get the money where it needs to go. This urgent matter could have been dealt with more quickly by other means.

Does not work. Gives "This application is not supported on rooted devices. Please contact carrier or vendor to restore an official Android release to your device." Used this app numerous times before, so what changed? Uninstalled the app and then reinstalled it. Says it's compatible with my device but the same message comes up about this application is not supported on rooted devices. It's the same phone I've used for all previous transactions, so what did you do to lock me out? Please fix

Horrible. Hasn't worked for over a month (edited to 1 star from 5 star). I used to use this app once or twice a month, but not since it stopped working. It would never stop loading when trying to send money. Now it won't even get past the western union screen to log in before I get an error message. I tried Uninstalling the app and even factory resetting my phone to no avail. I would never use this app if I didn't have to. I can only send my brother money via Western Union and its a shame.

I would give 0 stars if it was possible. I went in expecting to be able to buy a money order, give a security question / answer, and send the routing number / answer to my friend and he could pick it up. Not at ALL what happened. They FORCED me to download the app, and then it took FOREVER to load and create an account. The app is hard to navigate and I had to pay a $15 fee just to send money. I have never experienced anything like this before. Western Union used to be great but is now terrible.

Has become useless. Used to be great & easy. Sent money tons of times from my card to their card. Then suddenly they want me to call to authorize, & email a photo of my ID. Fine. Done. Next transaction (4 days later!) To the same account, they tell me To authorize this one (same process) too. Update: App is worse than ever. Gave it another chance, and now nothing but technical problems. Can't even log in 😂😂 Zero stars.

The worst experience I had with transferring the money out of the country. My transfer was put on hold, spoke with someone to verify everything, and they said everything was OK and then certainly received an email that my transfer got canceled. Called customer service and they said they couldn't access the reason for the cancellation. What is the point of calling previously to confirm everything and canceling after, this is ridiculous.

The service was lacking using the phone, switched to the app, and up until recently, seems each transaction has a questionaire, they call to interogate although been sending to the same people for years. Some questions are parental. Have you met the people?Whats it used for? Do you know them. Certainly they are the only ones in my profile. Just crazy, the parenting skills. I'm a senior, have'nt needed anyone to guide me as of yet. Oh and thanx for the annoying questions. Found a cheaper way 👍

Outright scam. They advertise that the first transaction is free, but they charge you for it! I called customer service and they say it's a known bug!! What the heck. The headline announcement advertising the free transfer works, but the actual credit does not?? They are all hoping that people accept it without question. That's what finance is all about nowadays. How to scam the public.

highly disappointed with the way the app works!!!! Better yet it never seems to work whenever I use it! Dollar general is the only store within a 15 mile radius of me so I always pick my money up there and of course you need the app to do so! The apps ALWAYS freezes up after I put the senders information in and never lets me hit "next"! I don't understand why it always does this! And it's not my phone because my husband is 3 hours away from me and it does the exact samething to him whenever he

Glitchy, unresponsive and slow at times. Every now and then, the app won't allow me to complete a transaction because the "process couldn't be completed using this payment method." (Or something along the lines of that) If I were to exit the app, repeat the transaction with the exact same payment method, it magically works without issue.

Let me start by saying this app was well worth a 5 star but as of now a one star would mean it works. This app does not work at all, you try to log in and it stays on the logo and the same error message I combined about prior. I have had to go online or in store. Its been well over 2 months this has been going on, if there is nothing that can be done to fix the error say so because its a waste of time and space on people's phones if its not going to work the way it should.

Gave up. WU hasn't kept up, very sad. I tried using this application on a Samsung Galaxy S3. I often see Western Union system errors. Which to me means this application is not really ready for primetime. this is unfortunate, because I like the features of this application. Couldn't get into my acct, escalated thru WU CS. They couldn't figure it out. Got a bunch of promo codes for the hassle. After 10 years am switching to another company. It is now September of 2018. The app is still not working. The kiosk in the local Walgreens store does not work. I'm able to send any transaction overseas via Western Union. Indian customer service completely useless, they follow a script and go to illogical Loops unable to solve anything. Very disappointing for a proud American company. Search Google there are other Alternatives that are much more modern and much cheaper. Good luck Western Union help you fix your problems!

If I could put a zero I would. At first I didnt have any problem until my transfer was put on hold for review. It's for a security reason which isn't a problem for me. They said to send an ID doc (which I did 3 TIMES) and wait 48 hours for release. A week gone by and nothing changed. I called to figure out what's going on and either: they cant find the tracking number or the system is messed up and to call back (which I did 5 times) or they never received it. Won't give a refund. Won't use again

Really, really horrible experience on both the app and the website. I wasn't even able to complete 1 simple transfer. It kept logging me off, even when I was actively using the website. On the rare occasion when I got to the final stage before submitting the transfer, I'd click "Next" and...nothing would happen. I spoke to 2 different customer support agents, and the extent of their advice was to clear my cache/cookies, delete all my payment info, and start again. Didn't help at all.

Still buggy after 7 more years of development. The photograph-to-add-card function DOES NOT WORK. ----- (original rewiew follows): I have just spent 45 minutes JUST ON THE REGISTRATION PROCESS.
